The print shop just called. They can't finish the brochures by Friday because their main press broke down.

That's a problem. We need them for the trade show on Saturday morning.

questions.content: Why did the print shop contact Ms. Mendes?
options: To report a problem with a machine
To offer a discount on a future order

questions.content: At 11:46 A.M., what does Mr. Park most likely mean when he writes, "Go ahead"?
options: He agrees to the additional expense.
He wants the order to be canceled.
He will pick up the brochures in Dayton.
He plans to print the brochures in the office.

Harlow Medical Supplies is seeking a Customer Account Coordinator for its regional office in Bristow. The successful candidate will respond to inquiries from hospitals and clinics, process orders, and resolve billing discrepancies.
Applicants should have at least two years of experience in customer service and be comfortable using inventory software. Familiarity with medical terminology is preferred but not required.
The position is full-time, Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday shifts during the end-of-quarter inventory count. Harlow offers a competitive salary, a transportation allowance, and tuition reimbursement for job-related courses.
To apply, send a résumé and two references to careers@harlowmed.com by March 15.

questions.content: What is one responsibility of the position?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'resolve billing discrepancies' = xử lý sai lệch hoá đơn (C).

questions.content: What is NOT listed as a benefit of the job?
options: Help with the cost of education
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 liệt kê 'competitive salary, a transportation allowance, and tuition reimbursement'; không nhắc ngày nghỉ phép thêm → (C).

questions.content: What is suggested about the position?
options: It requires a degree in a medical field.
It is based inside a hospital.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'occasional Saturday shifts during the end-of-quarter inventory count' → đôi khi làm cuối tuần (A). Kiến thức y khoa chỉ là 'preferred but not required'.

options: To announce a new shuttle route to the downtown area
To notify tenants of upcoming maintenance work
To request feedback on parking fees
To introduce a new facilities manager

questions.content: The word "run" in paragraph 2, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'A shuttle will run ... every ten minutes' = xe đưa đón sẽ chạy/hoạt động → operate (C). 'manage' là nghĩa của run khi nói về điều hành công ty.

questions.content: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Signs will be posted to remind drivers of this deadline."
questions.explanation: 'this deadline' phải nối với mốc '6:00 P.M. on Friday, September 12' ngay trước đó (xe để lại sẽ bị kéo) → vị trí [3] (C).

E-mail
From: Victor Hale
To: All Staff, Dunmore Legal
Date: February 3
Subject: Office move
As many of you know, our lease on the third-floor office ends on March 31, and we will be moving to the Kessler Building on Grant Avenue. To make the move go smoothly, I have requested quotes from three moving companies. Please label all personal items with your name and department by March 25. IT equipment will be packed separately by our technology team.

Moving Quotes
SwiftMove — $4,800 — weekend moves cost an extra $500
Carter & Sons — $5,200 — packing materials included
Metro Relocation — $4,500 — first available date: April 10

E-mail
From: Victor Hale
To: Linda Grey, Managing Partner
Date: February 10
Subject: Mover recommendation
Linda,
I recommend that we hire the least expensive company that can complete the move before our lease expires. They have also agreed to do the job on Saturday, March 29, so that no client appointments will be disrupted. With the weekend charge, the total ends up $100 higher than another quote we received, but this company's customer reviews are far better.
Victor

questions.content: Why is Dunmore Legal moving?
options: Its current building is being renovated.
Its lease is about to end.
It has merged with another firm.
questions.explanation: E-mail 1: 'our lease on the third-floor office ends on March 31' → hợp đồng thuê sắp hết (C).

questions.content: What are employees asked to do?
questions.explanation: E-mail 1: 'Please label all personal items with your name and department' → dán nhãn đồ cá nhân (B). Thiết bị IT do đội công nghệ đóng gói.

questions.content: Which company does Mr. Hale recommend?
questions.explanation: Công ty rẻ nhất là Metro Relocation nhưng sớm nhất 10/4, sau ngày hết hợp đồng 31/3. Trong hai công ty còn lại, SwiftMove rẻ hơn ($4,800) và có phụ phí cuối tuần đúng như e-mail 2 nhắc → (C).

questions.content: How much will the recommended move cost in total?
questions.explanation: SwiftMove $4,800 + phụ phí cuối tuần $500 (chuyển vào thứ Bảy 29/3) = $5,300, đúng là cao hơn báo giá Carter & Sons $100 → (D).

questions.content: Why does Mr. Hale want the move to take place on a Saturday?
options: To avoid interfering with client meetings
Because the new building is closed on weekdays
Because the IT team is free that day
questions.explanation: E-mail 2: 'so that no client appointments will be disrupted' → tránh ảnh hưởng lịch hẹn với khách (A). Làm cuối tuần còn tốn thêm $500 nên không rẻ hơn.
